Inge Nordgaard Lassen is a chief physician (*Cheflæge*) and Doctor of Medicine (*dr.med.*) representing the Capital Region of Denmark (*Region Hovedstaden*) [^src1]. She serves as a member of the steering group for the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] (DANIBD), the national clinical quality database for inflammatory bowel diseases [^src1]. 

In her capacity on the steering group, Lassen is a key figure for clinical leadership and quality management regarding Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) within the Capital Region [^src1]. The steering group functions as the strategic management unit for a broader national initiative aimed at systematizing and improving IBD treatment across Denmark [^src1]. This national effort relies on cross-regional quality measurement, standardized coding, and the evidence-based development of treatment guidelines, utilizing detailed clinical data and benchmarking metrics such as those collected between October 1, 2022, and September 30, 2023 [^src1].
